items.title: Built an Apple Health data flow
items.summary: Connected health data from setup through review, shutdown, and recovery.

items.title: Connected activity evidence to gear mileage
items.summary: Collected activity, let runners review it, and kept its mileage changes consistent.

items.title: Organised screens and their tests
items.summary: Put each screen’s code and tests in the same structure so changes are easier to find.

items.title: Clarified how the app’s parts work together
items.summary: Kept responsibilities, data ownership, and connections between the app’s parts clearer.

items.title: Removed the old Strava paths
items.summary: Removed unused provider data and tightened the remaining connection and cleanup checks.

items.title: Improved shoe matching
items.summary: Made it easier to match activity to the right catalogue shoe.

items.title: Kept build dependencies up to date
items.summary: Updated project dependencies and checks without changing app behavior.
